prompt: Hydroboration-oxidation of 2-methyl-2-butene (BH3·THF; then H2O2/NaOH). Draw the alcohol product.

answers.label: 3-methyl-2-butanol (anti-Markovnikov relative to the LESS substituted alkene C)

traps.note: Hydroboration gives anti-Markovnikov (OH on LESS substituted carbon).

explanation: BH3 adds syn across the alkene, with B on the less hindered carbon (steric control). H2O2/NaOH replaces B with OH, keeping its position. Net: anti-Markovnikov hydration, no rearrangement.
